description: The MEarth-North observatory is an array of eight robotically controlled 40 cm telescopes at FLWO dedicated to detecting transiting rocky exoplanets around nearby M dwarfs using a custom red-optical/near-infrared passband (iz).
facility_description: The Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory (FLWO) is located on Mount Hopkins, Arizona, and operated by the Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian.
notes: MEarth-North operates eight 40 cm f/9 Ritchey-Chretien telescopes equipped with Apogee Alta U42 CCDs and Schott RG715 longpass filters defining the custom iz bandpass. Data and site policies fall under the Smithsonian/CfA Open Access public domain terms.
